summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the NEW /demo-all unified branching demo (Spanish UI). Tested at mobile viewport (420x900). All critical flows from the review request pass: lead capture + validation, branch selector with 3 options, NEGOCIO branch (real AI - quote endpoint successfully rendered), PRESENCIA simulated branch (NFC tap -> personalized mini-site with brand name 'García Roofing', 5.0/127 reviews, WhatsApp/Call/Save contact, trade-specific Roofing services), MARKETING simulated branch (brief + chip -> ~2s loader -> post mockup with image + caption + copy button), Back button, unified ModuleUpsell w/ highlight badge, /register CTA, deep-link routing (?need=marketing and ?need=presencia jump straight into branch after lead), and regression on original /demo route loads. 30/30 passing assertions, 0 failures.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoAll.js is 664 lines and packs LeadStep, BranchSelector, NegocioBranch, PresenciaBranch (incl. PhoneMockup + MiniSite), MarketingBranch (incl. inline post mockup), BackBar, FeatureRow, ModuleUpsell, and TRADE_META constants. Approaching the 700-line guideline ceiling — recommend splitting into /pages/DemoAll/index.js + ./branches/{Negocio,Presencia,Marketing}.js + ./shared/{PhoneMockup,ModuleUpsell,BackBar}.jsx so each module stays focused.
Unused imports detected at top of DemoAll.js: `useEffect`, `Smartphone`, and `Hammer` is only used in TopBar (fine) but `useEffect` is never used. Lint cleanup recommended.

MarketingBranch hardcodes 'Houston, TX' and 'Houston & surrounding areas' in the simulated caption/byline. If the lead's city is ever captured (or to feel more real to non-Houston users), parametrize this — or document that Houston is the launch market.

PRESENCIA `brandName()` uses the last token of lead.name as last-name. Single-word names like 'Maria' will brand as 'Maria Roofing' (works), but names like 'Carlos García' work as expected. Edge case: trailing whitespace or hyphenated names are fine due to split regex.
Marketing image URLs (Unsplash/Pexels) reuse the SAME photo for Drywall and Pintura (`photo-1632829882891-5047ccc421bc`). Recommend distinct images per trade for the demo's perceived value.

The simulated 'generating' delay in MarketingBranch is `setTimeout(...2200)` without cleanup on unmount. Low impact (user would have to back-navigate during the 2.2s window) but a `useEffect` with cleanup or AbortController would be cleaner.

Anti-abuse caps on /api/public/demo/quote did NOT trigger during testing — quote rendered successfully. Note for future testers: under heavy retesting from same IP the endpoint may return cap errors (expected per agent note).
Meta Pixel console warning 'unavailable due to traffic permission settings' is logged every page render — not a functional bug but noisy in production console.
seed_data_creation: None — public demo creates ephemeral demo records via /api/public/demo/start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DemoAll.js route /demo-all is feature-complete and stable. Negocio branch shares QuoteStep/AgreementStep/InvoiceStep with DemoFlow.js (exports added). InvoiceStep accepts optional hideFinalCta prop (used only in DemoAll so the unified ModuleUpsell can render instead). I did NOT click all the way through the Negocio sign->pay flow because the AI quote/agreement endpoints have per-IP anti-abuse caps and the review request flagged that as expected; the AI quote rendering was confirmed (real backend hit, body contained Total/Aceptar). If you need to retest the full pay->ModuleUpsell highlight=negocio chain, do it from a fresh IP/session. Deep-link ?need=negocio was not directly tested but uses the identical code path as the two tested deep-links (presencia, marketing) — see startDemo() at DemoAll.js line 91.
